subject.title: Enhancement: Developer experience quick wins from code analysis

question: Should this umbrella stay open as one item, and which operator-visible surface should non-tool skill prompt rewrites use?
rationale: The code paths are clear, but the status performance boundary and prompt-rewrite diagnostic surface are product/UX choices rather than a purely mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Split and sponsor two focused follow-ups
options.body: Track status registry diagnostics separately from prompt-rewrite diagnostics, choose the warning surface first, and keep each implementation bounded with tests.

options.title: Keep this umbrella issue
options.body: Use this issue as the canonical tracker for both remaining quick wins, accepting that implementation and review will cross status, skills, docs, and tests.

options.title: Only keep status diagnostics
options.body: Treat Doctor/skills docs as enough for prompt-rewrite discovery and narrow the issue to status diagnostics only.

recommendation.title: Split and sponsor two focused follow-ups
recommendation.body: Track status registry diagnostics separately from prompt-rewrite diagnostics, choose the warning surface first, and keep each implementation bounded with tests.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete already posted the prior maintainer-context review and is the clearest routing candidate for deciding whether to split or sponsor the remaining UX surface.
